name: How long does an exterior house painting project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an exterior house painting project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior house painting project varies based on the size and complexity of the home, weather conditions, and the extent of preparation required. For an average-sized home, the process can take anywhere from 3 to 7 days, including all prep work, priming, and applying two coats of paint. Larger or more intricate homes, or those requiring significant repairs, might take longer. We provide a detailed timeline with every project estimate.
